identificationModule.briefTitle: Neoadjuvant and Adjuvant Sintilimab Combined with Chemoradiotherapy Versus Chemoradiotherapy Alone in Stage TanyN3M0 Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Neoadjuvant and Adjuvant Sintilimab Combined with Chemoradiotherapy Versus Chemoradiotherapy Alone in Stage TanyN3M0 Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma: a Multicenter, Open-label, Randomized Phase II Clinical Trial

leadSponsor.name: First Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of neoadjuvant and adjuvant Sintilimab combined with chemoradiotherapy versus chemoradiotherapy alone in stage TanyN3M0 nasopharyngeal carcinoma. The primary endpoint was 2-year failure-free survival (FFS). Secondary endpoints included 2-year overall survival (OS), distant failure-free survival (DFFS), locoregional failure-free survival (LRFFS), and adverse events.

interventions.name: Sintilimab
interventions.description: Induction chemotherapy stage: Sintilimab combined with GP regimen chemotherapy; Adjuvant chemotherapy stage: Sintilimab combined with Capecitabine
